name: Pacified
desc: A heavy calming scent has flooded this creature's senses, leaving it dazed and sluggish.
apply_message: The heavy scent hits you and everything goes foggy.
remove_message: The haze clears from your head.

name: Soothing Vapors
desc: Medicinal vapors are slowly closing wounds and easing pain.
apply_message: A gentle warmth washes over you as the healing vapors take effect.
remove_message: The healing vapors thin out and fade.

enchantments.//: The base_mods hurt healing only works on player characters; monsters ignore negative HURT values. This enchantment provides REGEN_HP which the monster process_effects loop honors directly, granting tamed creatures 5 HP per turn while affected.

name: Adrenaline Spike
desc: A surge of primal fury; muscles tense and reflexes sharpen to a razor edge.
apply_message: A jolt of adrenaline hits and everything sharpens.
remove_message: The adrenaline rush fades; exhaustion creeps in.

name: Adrenaline Crash
desc: The rush is gone; muscles ache, vision blurs, and every movement costs twice the effort.
apply_message: Your body buckles as the adrenaline wears off.
remove_message: You shake off the fatigue; your body feels normal again.
